text: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rise 29,000 in September as unemployment increases to 4.2%. Household employment rises 406,000 and the labor force expands by 485,000, while participation reaches 61.8%. July and August payroll revisions remove 60,000 previously reported jobs.

meta.note: Establishment and household surveys show materially different September labor-market configurations.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield rises to 5.26%, the 30-year to 5.619% and the 2-year to 4.818% after initially falling on September payroll data. Yields return to positive territory while market pricing shifts toward an unchanged federal funds rate in October.

meta.note: The intraday yield reversal coexists with lower market-implied expectations for an October rate increase.

text: Tesla delivers 486,532 vehicles in Q3, down 2% YoY but above Q2 and analyst estimates. Model 3 and Model Y account for 98% of deliveries. Energy-storage deployment reaches 13.7 GWh, above both the prior quarter and year-earlier period.

meta.note: Vehicle deliveries and energy-storage deployments use separate company-reported operating measures.

text: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison says the combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery entity will be named Skydance and trade as SKYD after the merger closes. Paramount and Warner Bros. remain distinct studio brands within the combined structure.

meta.note: The corporate identity changes at closing while the two principal studio identities remain preserved.

text: Ford reports 507,395 U.S. light-duty vehicle sales in Q3, down 6.6% YoY, while Hyundai, Kia and Genesis total 506,200, up 5.4%. Ford retains a 1,195-unit quarterly lead tas its EV sales fall roughly 80% from the year-earlier quarter.

meta.note: Hyundai's reported total combines three brands, while Ford's figure excludes its largest heavy-duty trucks.

text: G7 nations agree to a coordinated IEA release of 100 million barrels of diesel, crude and other reserves over four months, with substantial diesel volumes frontloaded within 20 days. Members also commit to refrain from energy export restrictions.

meta.note: The agreement does not specify the final product mix or individual country contributions.

text: The FAA determines that a software issue affecting certain Boeing 737 Max flight computers is not a flight-safety concern because pilots retain aircraft control and receive clear indications. The agency will issue guidance for recognizing and responding to the condition.

meta.note: The software condition remains documented despite its exclusion from the FAA's flight-safety classification.

text: The Justice Department says it will not reopen its criminal investigation into former Fed Chair Jerome Powell over the headquarters renovation. Separate action remains possible if an independent audit identifies evidence of criminal wrongdoing.

meta.note: The closed Powell investigation remains distinct from any action based on evidence arising from the separate audit.
